# Spectakles

> Make every voice count. Spectakles turns group discussions, practice sessions, and presentations into confident, measurable moments of participation for educational institutions.

## Core Information
- Website: https://spectakles.in/
- Mission: Helping students find their voice in group discussions and campus placement rounds through intelligent AI simulation and standard 5-parameter rubric assessment.

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://spectakles.in/): AI group discussion simulation, rubric breakdown, and placement prep.
- [About](https://spectakles.in/about): Mission, philosophy, and team behind Spectakles.
- [FAQ](https://spectakles.in/faq): Common questions from students and institutions regarding the platform.
